rounds.initialDisclosure: Merge PDF runs in your browser; files stay on this device and are not uploaded.

pdfToWord.supportText: PDF to Word runs in your browser; files stay on this device and are not uploaded.
pdfToWord.optionsDisclosure: Browser mode creates an editable text-first DOCX on this device and keeps page boundaries. It does not retain images, exact layout, or table structure; use Server Processing for supported table/layout reconstruction. Scanned PDFs need OCR first.
